name: Chocolatey Coconut & Walnut "Banana Bread" Cookie Ice Cream Sandwich

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a large bowl.
Add sugar, oil, and vanilla to the bowl with the banana. Crush with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl along with the coconut; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup walnuts
1 cup shredded unsweetened coconut

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, cocoa powder, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup all-purpose flour
3 tbsp cocoa powder
¾ tsp cornstarch
½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add flour mixture to the bowl with the banana and stir to combine the cookie batter.
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, divide batter into 12 portions and place on the baking sheets. Using a rubber spatula or the back of a spoon, spread each cookie into a 2-inch circle.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until cookies are slightly firm around the edges, 15-17 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.

Once cool, arrange half the cookies on a flat surface, bottom-side facing up. Place a scoop of ice cream on top of each, then cover with remaining cookies. Gently press cookies into the ice cream to secure the sandwiches.
To serve, divide ice cream sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
